grader.scenario: Hub 5 router overheating and flashing red after being placed in enclosed TV cabinet
grader.notes: Router overheating call handled by Connor. Customer moved Hub 5 into an enclosed oak cabinet next to other electronics, causing thermal throttling. Agent diagnosed the thermal issue accurately and paraphrased well, but failed Professionalism with a rude sarcastic remark, failed Ownership by refusing replacement support, and failed Confirmed Resolved by abruptly cutting off the customer.
